import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX = 31;
    static final long P = 1000000007L;
    static int n;
    static long[][] pom = new long[MAX][MAX];

    static class Matrix {
        long[][] t = new long[MAX][MAX];

        void id() {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    t[i][j] = (i == j) ? 1 : 0;
                }
            }
        }

        void multiply(Matrix b) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    pom[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                        pom[i][k] += t[i][j] * b.t[j][k] % P;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    t[i][j] = pom[i][j] % P;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long m = sc.nextLong();
        int k = sc.nextInt();

        List<Long> roz = new ArrayList<>();
        while (m != 0) {
            roz.add(m % k);
            m /= k;
        }

        n = k + 1;

        Matrix obr = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            obr.t[i][(i + 1) % k] = 1;
        }
        obr.t[k][k] = 1;

        Matrix nl = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            nl.t[0][i] = 1;
            nl.t[i][i] = 1;
        }

        Matrix[] d = new Matrix[roz.size()];
        d[0] = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            d[0].t[0][i] = 1;
            d[0].t[i][i] = 1;
        }

        d[0].multiply(obr);

        for (int i = 1; i < roz.size(); i++) {
            d[i] = new Matrix();
            d[i].id();
            for (int _ = 0; _ < k; _++) {
                d[i].multiply(d[i - 1]);
            }
            d[i].multiply(obr);
        }

        long[] wyn = new long[n];
        Arrays.fill(wyn, 1);

        for (int ii = roz.size() - 1; ii >= 0; ii--) {
            long[] pw = new long[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                pw[i] = 0;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    pw[j] += wyn[i] * d[ii].t[i][j] % P;
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                wyn[i] = pw[i] % P;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(wyn[k]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
